summary: Primary-source lift over 60 medium-confidence records taken in descending order of significance weight, in two waves of five research subagents and three independent reviewers each. For every record the stage-deciding official document was located and read on a primary host where one was reachable, its citation confirmed, and the stage, progress and confidence re-derived in independent review. Four records changed stage, all downward: c07-19 (in_progress 25 to proposed 20, EO 14369 only directs plans and the FY2026 intelligence authorization has no space provision), c15-14 (in_progress 25 to proposed 10, P.L. 119-101 section 212 and HUD Notice PIH 2026-23 expand RAD and ease disposition under existing authority but grant no land-sale or voucher-mobility authority), c18-18 (in_progress 35 to proposed 15, the DOL unemployment insurance data rule of 2026-09-16 reaches inspector general access by regulation rather than the statute the text asks Congress to enact), and c13-07 (implemented 65 to blocked 50, the Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund terminations are under an injunction upheld by the en banc D.C. Circuit on 2026-08-04 and two district courts vacated the Solar for All termination in September 2026, per secondary accounts). Progress moved without a stage change on c21-02 (35 to 25), c05-28 (45 to 35), c09-05 (45 to 35) and c04-20 (35 to 40). Nineteen records moved to high confidence; one (c05-28) moved to low because the inspector general report its practice claims rest on could not be opened. Records resting on sections of Public Law 119-21, 119-60, 119-74, 119-75 and 119-101 beyond the reachable part of the enrolled text stayed medium. Counted set unchanged at 627. About 50 of 200 searches used.
title: Primary-source lift: 60 medium-confidence records re-read against their deciding documents
